record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.original_question: Classify, up to equivalence by a polynomial automorphism of C^2 and an affine automorphism of C, the primitive polynomials p(x,y) in two complex variables that have a fiber isomorphic to C*. Equivalently, determine a list of non-equivalent models such that every primitive polynomial with a C*-fiber is equivalent to one of them.

evidence.quote: PROBLEM. Find the list of non-equivalent polynomials such that every primitive polynomial p with a C∗ -ﬁber is equivalent to one of polynomials from this list.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{C}^* = \mathbb{C} \setminus \{0\}$. A polynomial $p \in \mathbb{C}[x,y]$ is called primitive if it cannot be written in the form $p = q \circ r$ for some polynomials $r \in \mathbb{C}[x,y]$ and $q \in \mathbb{C}[t]$ with $\deg q \geq 2$; equivalently, the generic fiber of the map $p \colon \mathbb{C}^2 	o \mathbb{C}$ is irreducible. For $c \in \mathbb{C}$, the fiber of $p$ at $c$ is the affine algebraic curve $p^{-1}(c) = \{(x,y) \in \mathbb{C}^2 : p(x,y) = c\}$.

Declare two polynomials $p, p' \in \mathbb{C}[x,y]$ equivalent if there exist a polynomial automorphism $\Phi$ of $\mathbb{C}^2$ (an element of the affine Cremona group, i.e., a polynomial map $\mathbb{C}^2 	o \mathbb{C}^2$ with polynomial inverse) and an affine automorphism $\alpha(t) = at + b$ of $\mathbb{C}$ (with $a \in \mathbb{C}^*$, $b \in \mathbb{C}$) such that
$$p'(x,y) = \alpha igl(p(\Phi(x,y)) igr).$$

Problem. Produce an explicit list $\mathcal{L}$ of pairwise non-equivalent primitive polynomials in $\mathbb{C}[x,y]$ such that every primitive polynomial $p \in \mathbb{C}[x,y]$ admitting at least one fiber $p^{-1}(c)$ isomorphic (as an affine algebraic variety) to $\mathbb{C}^*$ is equivalent, in the above sense, to exactly one polynomial of $\mathcal{L}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches did not return a definitive published classification of all primitive polynomials in $\mathbb{C}[x,y]$ having a $\mathbb{C}^*$-fiber up to the stated equivalence. Related work by Neumann–Norbury on rational polynomials of simple type, by Sasao on dicriticals of degree 2, and by Cassou-Noguès–Daigle addresses adjacent classifications, but a complete and verified list resolving this specific problem could not be confirmed. Status is recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.snippet: Neumann and Norbury study rational polynomials of simple type, a class adjacent to polynomials with C*-fibers.
status_evidence.claim: Related classification results exist for rational polynomials of simple type, but do not directly settle the C*-fiber classification.

status_evidence.snippet: Cassou-Noguès and Daigle revisit gaps in classifications of rational polynomials of simple type.
